settings.description: Tracks Hiveblood: syncs from Genesis Tree (+ Breach popups). Visit the tree once to calibrate.
settings.also_inventory_closed: Also show when inventory is closed
settings.offset_from_anchor.tooltip: Bottom anchor: left edge of the inventory panel, just above the gold line. Drag X/Y to fine-tune.
settings.show_position_dummy.tooltip: Shows a draggable preview in-game and saves a fixed screen position. Switches to custom screen position.
settings.warn_from_amount.tooltip: Above the threshold the overlay text turns orange-red and blinks. It is also shown while the inventory is closed (at the last in-inventory position).
settings.show_session_gains: Show gains since last tree sync
settings.scan_interval.tooltip: How often the plugin reads the game UI tree. Lower values react faster but use more CPU (default 300).
position_dummy.hint: Drag to move. Disable dummy in settings when done.
